# LearnCraft EDU — llms.txt
# AI-powered curriculum authoring and LMS platform
# https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca

## Platform Overview
LearnCraft EDU is an AI-powered curriculum authoring and learning management platform.
It offers two paths: Marketplace (create & sell courses) and Enterprise (branded corporate LMS).

## Key Pages
- Home: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/
- Marketplace: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/marketplace — Create. Sell. Earn. For freelance instructors.
- Enterprise: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/enterprise — Train. Track. Transform. For corporate L&D teams.
- Browse Courses: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/marketplace/courses — Public course storefront.
- Plans & Pricing: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/plans
- Terms: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/terms
- Privacy: https://learncraft.mediasurf.ca/privacy

## Core Features
- AI Course Outline Generator: transforms topics into structured lesson plans
- 20+ interactive content block types (video, quiz, flip cards, code demos, etc.)
- Drag-and-drop course builder — no coding required
- Built-in WCAG 2.1 accessibility audits
- SCORM & xAPI export for any LMS
- Engagement analytics with visual heatmaps
- White-label enterprise portal with SSO/SCIM
- Stripe Connect marketplace payouts (80% revenue share for instructors)

## For Instructors (Marketplace)
- Create courses with AI assistance
- Set your own price (free to $99.99+)
- List on marketplace reaching learners
- Earn 80% revenue share via Stripe
- Real-time sales dashboard and analytics

## For Enterprise / Business
- Deploy a branded corporate LMS in days
- SSO (SAML/OIDC) + SCIM provisioning
- Role-based learning paths
- Compliance tracking and certification management
- Manager reporting dashboard
- HRIS integrations (Workday, BambooHR, Azure AD, Okta)

## Technical
- Built with Vue 3, Vite, Firebase
- SPA with server-side meta via @unhead/vue
- JSON-LD structured data for SEO
- PWA-ready with manifest and service worker
